entries.285399c0cae654a3: This reportable segment sells new aerial work platform vehicles and other vehicles, with net sales to external customers of ¥44,652 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (down 3% from the prior year) and gross profit of ¥7,607 million. The company manufactures hole-digging pole-erecting trucks, aerial work platforms, skid-steer loaders and other specialty vehicles and sells them in Japan and overseas. In China, consolidated subsidiary Zhejiang Aichi Gongcheng Jixie Co., Ltd. manufactures aerial work machines, and equity-method affiliate Hangzhou Aichi Gongcheng Cheliang Co., Ltd. manufactures specialty vehicles, including aerial work platforms; in New Zealand, consolidated subsidiary AICHI NZ LIMITED sells the company's products. The securities report gives the reason for the sales decline as mainly lower sales to the electric power industry. The securities report also notes that carryover sales arose in the first quarter of the prior year from the resolution of a chassis certification issue for truck-mounted aerial work platforms.
entries.2a88f31f25648eda: The largest category in the breakdown of Specialty Vehicles in [Sales Results]. Its sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were up 4.7% year on year. The securities report states that the company is the top manufacturer of aerial work platforms, maintaining a high share in Japan, and is particularly dependent on the electrical and telecommunications construction and rental industries.
entries.2d69b98a1e7a5bdd: A category that handles used-vehicle sales of aerial work platforms and others and education business, among others; the securities report describes it as an "operating segment not included in reportable segments." The company also conducts training related to aerial work platforms and others.

entries.7bb826ac77b0a9cd: This reportable segment provides after-sales services for aerial work platform vehicles and other products, mainly parts sales and repairs. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥14,061 million (up 11%), and gross profit was ¥5,199 million (up 18%). The company provides after-sales services, including parts sales and repairs, in Japan and overseas, and Zhejiang Aichi Gongcheng Jixie Co., Ltd., AICHI NZ LIMITED and Hangzhou Aichi Gongcheng Cheliang Co., Ltd. each provide parts sales, repairs and other services in their respective countries. The securities report states that the increase in net sales was mainly due to higher repair sales, and that the company pursued initiatives including one-stop service development, proposals for preventive maintenance and capturing vehicle inspection work.
